$comment: Vortex-agent QA manifest — declares how THIS repo is QA'd. Read by the reconciler; keeps the agent core repo-agnostic.

web.notes: Seal's native web QA is Playwright e2e (Seal has NO preview-deploy / wrangler-versions flow). Before running, set VITE_CONVEX_URL to a Convex preview you create from apps/backend (`bunx convex deploy --preview-create <name>` using CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY) so the e2e hits an isolated backend. Optional: point Playwright at the shared browserless VPS ($BROWSERLESS_URL) via CDP instead of a local browser.
